name: Social IQa: Commonsense Reasoning about Social Interactions
description: Social IQa is a large-scale question answering benchmark for assessing social commonsense intelligence in neural language models. It contains 37,588 multiple-choice questions focusing on emotional states, intentions, social motivations, and likely subsequent actions across diverse interpersonal scenarios.
